name: How long does a roof deck condition assessment take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a roof deck condition assessment take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a roof deck condition assessment varies depending on the size and complexity of your roof. A typical residential assessment might take a few hours, while larger commercial properties could require more time. We prioritize thoroughness to ensure all potential issues are identified. After the assessment, we aim to provide you with a detailed report within a few business days, outlining our findings and recommendations.
acceptedAnswer.description: The assessment duration depends on roof size and complexity, typically a few hours for residential, with a report provided within days.
